prompt: How do I schedule an email in Outlook?
completion:
## How to Schedule an Email in Outlook Scheduling (or “Send Later”) lets you draft a message now and have it automatically sent at a specified date & time. Below are step‑by‑step guides for the most common Outlook clients: | Platform | How to Schedule | Key Notes | |----------|----------------|-----------| | **Outlook 365 / Outlook 2019‑2021 (Windows)** | 1. Compose a new message.
2. On the **Message** tab, click **More Options** (triangle) → **Delay Delivery**.
3. In the “Delivery options” pane, check **Do not deliver before** and pick your date/time.
4. Click **Close** → **Send**. | Message is stored in the **Outbox** until the scheduled time. | | **Outlook 2013‑2016 (Windows)** | Same as above (Delay Delivery is available). | | | **Outlook for Mac (2016‑2023)** | 1. Compose a new email.
2. Click the **Options** tab → **Send Later** (or **Schedule Send**).
3. Pick the date/time.
4. Confirm. | The message stays in **Outbox** until sent. | | **Outlook on the Web (OWA)** | 1. Compose a new mail.
2. Click the arrow next to **Send** → **Send later**.
3. Choose the date/time.
4. Confirm. | Works even if your computer is off (the server sends it). | | **Outlook Mobile (iOS/Android)** | 1. Compose a new email.
2. Tap the **three‑dot** menu → **Schedule Send**.
3. Set date/time.
4. Confirm. | The message is stored in the cloud until the time. | --- ### Detailed Steps for Outlook (Windows) 1. **Open Outlook** and click **New Email**. 2. Write your message as usual. 3. In the **Message** ribbon, click the tiny **down‑arrow** next to **Options** → **Delay Delivery** (or simply click **Options** → **Delay Delivery**). 4. In the dialog that appears, under **Delivery options**, tick **Do not deliver before**. 5. Pick the exact **date** and **time** you want the message sent. 6. Click **Close**, then **Send**. - The email moves to your **Outbox** and remains there until the scheduled time. - If Outlook is closed or your computer is off, the email will still be sent when Outlook reconnects to the server (usually after a reboot or when Outlook starts again). ### Quick “Send Later” Shortcut (Windows) If you want a faster route: - After composing, click **Send** (it will actually move to the Outbox). - In the Outbox, double‑click the message to open it again. - Go to **Message** → **More Options** → **Delay Delivery** → set date/time → **Close** → **Send**. ### Things to Watch Out For | Issue | Fix | |-------|-----| | **Message stuck in Outbox forever** | Ensure Outlook is connected to the internet; check the **Send/Receive** tab → **Send/Receive Groups** → **Define Send/Receive Groups** → select **All Accounts** → **Edit** → **Check Outbox**. | | **Scheduled send fails after a computer restart** | Outlook must be running or at least *started* for the server to send. If you log out or shut down, Outlook will try again when it opens next. | | **Want to cancel the scheduled send** | Open the message in Outbox → click **Send** again (it will send immediately) or delete it. | | **Scheduling on a shared mailbox** | Right‑click the shared mailbox → **Properties** → **Outlook Web App** → you can schedule from the web or use the Outlook client if you have full rights. | ### Outlook for Mac – Using “Send Later” 1. Compose a message. 2. On the **Message** tab, click **Send Later** (or **Schedule Send** depending on version). 3. A small dialog will appear; choose the desired date and time. 4. Confirm. - The message stays in **Outbox** until the scheduled time. ### Outlook on the Web (OWA) 1. Click **New message**. 2. Type your email. 3. Click the **arrow** beside **Send** → **Send later**. 4. Pick your date/time and confirm. - Works even when you’re not logged in; the server handles the timing. ### Outlook Mobile (iOS/Android) 1. Compose an email. 2. Tap the **three‑dot** icon (⋮) → **Schedule Send**. 3. Choose the date/time and confirm. - The email remains in your account’s cloud until it’s dispatched. --- ## Recap | Platform | Shortcut | Where it stays until sent | |----------|----------|---------------------------| | Windows (desktop) | Delay Delivery dialog | Outbox | | Mac (desktop) | Send Later | Outbox | | Outlook on the Web | Send later menu | Outbox | | Mobile | Schedule Send | Cloud | With these steps, you can time your emails to arrive at exactly the right moment—whether you’re out of the office, sleeping, or just want to give a message a “future” feel. Happy scheduling!
